core_obligations: Reduce to a point (proof lines 6168-6180): since the required morphism may be assembled from finitely many local pieces, the author reduces to producing, for a given point u of an etale U over X, an etale V over Y together with a morphism X x_Y V -> U whose image contains u.
Isolate the fibre (proof lines 6177-6180): using that the morphism is integral and a homeomorphism onto its image, the author shrinks U so that the fibre of u consists of u alone.

Complete the construction (proof lines 6182-6195): the image of U is open in X and hence has locally closed image in Y, and the author uses the companion property (B) for the same morphism to find an etale covering of a suitable open of Y whose base changes factor through U, which produces the required V and morphism.
proof_roadmap: Reduce to handling one point of an etale U over X.
Shrink U so that the fibre of the point is a single point, using integrality and the homeomorphism hypothesis.
Use property (B) for the same morphism to produce an etale cover of the base whose base change factors through U.
difficulty_reason: The lemma verifies property (C) for an integral morphism which is a homeomorphism of X onto a closed subset of Y (statement lines 6161-6166, with property (C) delivered verbatim as a context span from lines 5708-5726). The proof reduces the construction to a single point of an etale U over X (proof lines 6168-6180), uses integrality and the homeomorphism hypothesis to shrink U so that the fibre of the point is a single point (proof lines 6177-6180), and then appeals to the companion property (B) for the same morphism to find an etale covering of the base whose base changes factor through U (proof lines 6182-6195). The non-formal content is the reduction to a point together with the use of property (B). The claim is H2: one reduction plus one application of the companion result.
